messages:
Jin: evening handoff — I'm off in 30. Quick digest:
- Rollout: dedicated-secondary pool update finished 18:05 UTC; keep an eye on tail latency for gpt-medium.
- Watch: KV eviction spikes on embed-cache node r4-3 (saw ~3 spikes in last hour). Prefetches falling off.
- Action: @Priya to review eviction tuning and bump params if needed.
- PRs: #4824 (batcher backpressure) needs review, @Mateo please take a look.
- FYI: noisy tenant 'search-toys' will be rate-limited at ~19:00 UTC; expect ~5–10% dropped requests during ramp.
- Ops tip: run ./ops/scripts/diagnose_cache.sh if you see evictions.
Thanks — Jin

Priya: ack. I'll pull metrics now (checking eviction_rate, cache_size, and prefetch miss rate). If eviction_rate > 2% over baseline I'll bump kv.max_items to 1.2M and post the change here.

Mateo: on #4824 — I can review in ~15m. Note I added a tiny log to the batcher to surface queue depth:
```
logger.info("batcher_q", {"depth": len(queue)})
```
should help correlate backpressure with latency spikes.

Riley: re: the noisy tenant, is there a canary/fallback route we can hit to test the fallback behavior without touching the dedicated pool?

Jin: @Riley yes — use route `search-toys-fallback` (e.g., POST /v1/generate?route=search-toys-fallback). It targets a small-capacity variant and should exercise fallback wiring.

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2026-11-05 02:00 UTC. No rolling restarts scheduled for tonight.

Oncall-bot: If p95 latency > 1200ms for model gpt-medium, escalate to #eng-sre and ping @oncall.

Mateo: quick Q — how do I repro embed-cache eviction locally to validate a change?

Jin: run the local repro:
```
docker-compose up embed-test
curl -sS localhost:8080/alloc -d '{"size":1000000}'
./ops/scripts/diagnose_cache.sh
```
That sequence will simulate load and produce the eviction traces.

Priya: I'll post results here in ~20m. Leaving at 19:15 UTC — if evictions persist, @Mateo please take over monitoring and any quick rollbacks.

Mateo: will pick up after 19:15. If I don't post, assume stable and feel free to spin down the extra debug logging tomorrow. Have a good evening :wave:
